content.short: Arcana Network provides Web3 infra to onboard users with social or email login and to create non-custodial wallets.
content.description: Arcana Network delivers Web3 infrastructure for developers to launch and scale applications with the Auth, Store, and Access SDKs. Arcana Auth is the first product to launch on Mainnet. By integrating Auth, developers can streamline Web3 authentication and boost user conversion rates by up to 90% through plug-and-play social or email login. Users receive in-app and non-custodial wallets to sign transactions and manage tokens and NFTs, without installing plugins. Gasless transactions and crypto on-ramps enable a seamless user experience.
content.meta: Arcana Network is Web3 infra to launch and scale apps with Auth, Store, & Access SDK. Discover Arcana Network and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
